notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least five cards this turn.
description:
Cast Chromatic Orrery by paying at most {2} due to Heliod.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {2} due to Heliod and Chromatic Orrery.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for Paradoxical Outcome, if needed, and putting it into your hand.
Cast Paradoxical Outcome by paying {1} due to Heliod and Chromatic Orrery, returning Chromatic Orrery and Invasion of Arcavios from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If opponents have drawn six or more cards this turn, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
